title: PTP value and Sony property-data decoders still read without a reply length
summary: Residual of audit 019/026 found by the fix review. ptp_sony_decode_property() walks GetAllDevicePropData by the received count without the buffer size; ptp_decode_property_value() (Fuji and Olympus value polls) decodes strings and numbers without a size; Canon AvailListChanged image-format entries are bounded by count, not by their variable size. Writes on these paths are now capacity-checked, so the remaining impact is reads past the reply (USB pads 1024 zeroed bytes, ICA does not). Source-only, not reproduced. Next: pass the reply end into these decoders and add fake truncated-reply cases.
evidence: indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp_sony.c ptp_sony_decode_property and its GetAllDevicePropData callers; indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp.c ptp_decode_property_value; indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp_canon.c ptp_event_canon_AvailListChanged
